full_details: The plot hung by the stage door. Burbage found the size of the part before the morning ended. Arthur's hooks had split, and they were not mended. Larkham would not recopy until one book was the book. Nothing was pasted. At the lodging that night the line ended on a plain word, the speech before it was shortened, and you pencilled two jokes about a lady of uncommon stature. The firing was not restarted.
one_sentence: On a yard three times the Cross Keys, Cowley missed a Latin cue three times, and you found your own correction sitting on the wrong copy.
title: The correction was on the wrong copy
